key_facts: Aug 17 UPDATE (T+1d; Exa Aug 15-17 Pakistan Today/The News/BBC Urdu/India Today major pre-hearing filing; UPDATED Shifa International 0.56->0.58, PIMS 0.29->0.33, Al-Shifa Trust Eye Hospital 0.09->0.04, CMH 0.02, replaced AFIO 0.02 with Armed Forces Institute of Cardiology 0.01; sum 0.98): On Mon Aug 17—one day before the Tue Aug 18 hearing before the independent-leaning 3-judge SC bench (Justice Shahid Waheed, Justice Naeem Akhtar Afghan, Justice Ishtiaq Ibrahim)—Adiala Jail Superintendent submitted Imran Khan's official medical report to the Supreme Court. CRITICAL SHIFT: The jail report claims Khan's right-eye CRVO improved significantly after PIMS/Al-Shifa specialist care and his vision is "almost normal", asking the SC to dismiss the plea—HOWEVER, attached Aug 1 & Aug 10 medical board (eye, cardiology, medicine) records document "Level 3+ severe anxiety", fluctuating BP (140/80), palpitations, headache, and restlessness. PTI Chairman Barrister Gohar and Sheikh Waqas Akram rejected the jail report, argued it vindicates health concerns, and categorically demanded immediate transfer to Shifa International Hospital under personal doctors Dr Asim Yousaf and Dr Faisal Sultan, specifically pressing for recommended Coronary CT Angiography. Because the clinical debate shifted away from eye-only treatment toward multi-system/cardiac/comprehensive evaluation, eye-only hospitals (Al-Shifa Trust Eye Hospital 0.09->0.04, AFIO dropped) lose mass to full-service tertiary hospitals: Shifa International Hospital rises 0.56->0.58 (explicitly petitioned before independent bench; kept safely below <=0.65 unpublished-order guardrail) and PIMS rises 0.29->0.33 (classic federal tertiary-hospital compromise if bench wants comprehensive/cardiac tests with personal doctors observing).
